claims.claim: Direct SET_TOKEN replacement can preserve prior refresh identity
claims.qualification: The public dispatcher supports direct token replacement. No local non-test call to that dispatcher was found. Known fresh v2/v3 login paths explicitly invalidate and clear refresh. External callers and identity replacement behavior are unverified.

claims.claim: Server-mode build pairs production mode with development remote
claims.qualification: The file identifies the cdups-dev remote. Whether a production build uses this file or overrides it is unknown. This is already a conditional build provenance finding.

claims.claim: Babel parser makes TypeScript lint fail without suitable preset
claims.qualification: A TypeScript preset is declared and the selected TypeScript file passed eslint parsing without fixes. This single-file check does not establish full repository lint success.

claims.claim: Token replacement without logout does not increment epoch
claims.qualification: v2/v3 login increments the epoch on request and on successful response. Direct external token dispatch has no epoch invalidation, but reachable usage and behavioral impact are unverified.
